name: deja-vu
description: Memory from the coding sessions already on this machine — recalled before each turn, searchable as tools

bin.description: Path to the deja binary. Default: DEJA_BIN, the deja on PATH, the usual install locations, then the copy bundled with this package.

autoRecall.description: Put relevant history in front of the model before each turn. Default true.

tools.description: Register deja_recall, deja_fix and deja_blame. Default true.

receipt.description: In a 1:1 chat with the owner on a channel, add deja's one-line "you've been here" receipt under a reply that was answered from history. Default true.
